source_snapshot.procedure: Test connections between BMC I2C-2 and HPM0.
source_snapshot.criteria: BMC can successfully communicate with I2C devices on first HPM.
source_snapshot.script: AI_VR_I2C_bus2; related path mentions AI_VR_I2C_bus1; 10 attended/10 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; proposes BMC i2cdetect/i2cget plus operator physical inspection, but literal bus and safe transactions are unproven.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/MEDIUM; held Pending for BMC controller/mux/HPM0 map, expected identities, safe read allowlist, physical evidence and recovery.

old_problem: A literal I2C-2 scan may address the wrong BMC adapter/mux or issue transactions unsafe for live VRs/EEPROMs. An ACK does not prove HPM0/first-HPM identity, while software cannot prove connector seating.
disposition_reason: The required result is clear and can be safely specified without inventing OEM parameters: an operator proves the HPM0/1P physical path, then an approved BMC/OOB read-only method verifies the project-supplied controller/mux/channel and device-identity oracle. The topology, addresses/registers and exact vendor command remain runtime Project Configuration, with a closed gate until supplied.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2157, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2158 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00045-V003 / 8c5947f462d0cc3e was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Wistron I2C is BMC/platform-management scope; bind logical I2C-2 to the exact BMC controller, adapter, mux/channel and HPM0 connector rather than treating the label as a Linux adapter number.
Bind the approved 1P population and HPM0-specific 7-bit addresses, stable identity registers/masks/values and prohibited transaction list.
Operator inspection and timestamped photos remain mandatory physical evidence; software evidence does not replace them.
Use only the owner/vendor-approved BMC inventory or allowlisted read-only transactions; no generic quick-write scan, unknown register access, EEPROM/control write, blind reset or retry.
PASS requires both target-bound physical evidence and every expected HPM0 identity response with clean bus/BMC health.
No BMC/I2C query, physical manipulation, write, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: HPM0 1P physical and BMC I2C-2 identity validation
test_case.purpose: Prove the first populated HPM is physically connected to the intended BMC I2C-2 path and every required HPM0 device is safely reachable and identity-matched through the correct controller and mux channel.
required_package: HPM0 device address and stable identity register/value allowlist plus prohibited transactions
Vendor-approved non-destructive BMC/OOB inventory or read-only method
BMC access/log collection and operator physical-inspection/photo procedure
Bus-error acceptance, abort and vendor recovery procedure
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. With the system in the approved inspection state, the operator verifies and photographs the HPM0/first-HPM/1P connection. Then use only the approved BMC/OOB inventory or mapped allowlisted read-only transactions to collect every expected HPM0 identity and pre/post bus-health record; do not infer a literal adapter number or run a generic scan.
test_case.expected_result: Target-bound photos prove the HPM0 1P physical path; every expected device responds on the mapped BMC I2C-2 mux path with the approved identity value; no missing/unexpected device, wrong-channel substitution, timeout, stuck bus, error storm or BMC instability occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires both physical evidence and complete identity-oracle reconciliation with clean bus health. FAIL on any missing/mismatched/unexpected device, wrong path, physical defect or bus/BMC fault. Missing topology/oracle/safe method is runtime BLOCKED, not a reason to invent parameters.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until topology, device oracle, safe transactions, inspection state and recovery are signed.
Physical connector work is operator-only under the service procedure.
No unknown-address scan/read, quick-write, EEPROM/control write, blind reset or automatic retry.
Stop on topology ambiguity, timeout, NACK pattern outside oracle, stuck bus, arbitration/error storm or BMC instability.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approval and 1P/HPM0 population record
BMC controller/adapter/mux/channel map and address/register/value allowlist
Exact approved command/method and complete HPM0 identity response table
Pre/post BMC/I2C timeout/NACK/arbitration/stuck-bus logs and health
test_case.recovery: On a bus or BMC fault, stop and preserve outputs/photos. Use only the vendor-approved BMC/I2C recovery for the mapped path; do not issue writes, blind resets or rescans. Quarantine and escalate if management health does not return to the preserved baseline.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently identify BMC I2C-2 to HPM0/first-HPM in the 1P state; bundle/path labels require mapping, not a new objective.

blocked.reason: Purpose, hybrid evidence and safe validation pattern are complete; runtime is gated on project topology, oracle, approved method and operator evidence.
